mintAuthority.summary: NXUSD is a BoringOwnable CDP stablecoin; mint() is onlyOwner. The owner is a Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 with 2-of-3 threshold on Avalanche — no modules, no guard — that administers the NXUSD token and Nereus CDP parameters.

mintIncidents.summary: A flash-loan manipulation of the AVAX/USDC JLP collateral price let an attacker borrow far more NXUSD than justified by collateral, creating about $500K of NXUSD bad debt.

controls.capDescription: NXUSD uses BoringOwnable; mint() rate-limits to 15% of total supply per 24h window.
controls.evidence: At Avalanche block 90243848, NXUSD owner() remained Safe 0xdd3de3b819edd3a014fda93868d7dfc873341467. The Safe was 2-of-3 with no modules, zero guard and module guard, fixed singleton 0xfb1bffc9d739b8d520daf37df666da4c687191ea, and standard CompatibilityFallbackHandler 0x017062a1de2fe6b99be3d9d37841fed19f573804. NXUSD is a direct 5007-byte deployment whose EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots were all zero. Verified source shows mint() is onlyOwner with a 15% per-24h rate limiter.

review.evidence: At Avalanche block 90243848, NXUSD was a direct 5007-byte deployment with zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots. Its onlyOwner mint path remained controlled by Safe 0xdd3de3b819edd3a014fda93868d7dfc873341467, still 2-of-3 with no modules or guard. The Safe can operate minting and CDP parameters but cannot replace the deployed NXUSD bytecode. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the owner Safe can mint repeatedly under a rolling 15%-of-supply daily limit, while no whole-supply collateral reconciliation, independent attestation, or named prudential supervisor is evidenced. Wave 2 external verification 2026-08-15: Nereus dashboards, deployment records, DefiLlama, and the Ambisafe code audit did not provide assets-and-liabilities reconciliation across Avalanche and Polygon. Sol reconciliation adjudication 2026-08-15: the owner Safe's repeatable onlyOwner mint path exists outside borrower-facing CDP collateral gating; because no whole-supply collateral reconciliation covering that escape path is evidenced, reconciliation is applicable but unknown.
